identity.subject: test(capture): cover Android session ownership failures

contracts.conclusion: Only the run command boundary is modeled. RecordingDevice supplies actual reused property replies and command recording. Canonical shell/push_text and local TemporaryDirectory/write/read are retained; super._start is called and its exact escaping original is observed/rethrown.
contracts.limit: Modeled remote file/port/debug/running state, not an Android device. Injected faults occur after RecordingDevice logs the command but before modeled effects; no OS command success/failure claim.

contracts.conclusion: Direct finite modeled-state backup is registered before acquisition; backup_started must remain false at target observations. No canonical retries or swallowing backup exceptions. Actual local temp-file cleanup occurs in canonical context; unittest invokes backup on success/failure.

Exact original refusal plus only getprop commands distinguishes refusing before mutation. patch.dict clears opt-in environment only in synchronous bounded refusal observation and restores it on all exits.

The fault is exact controlled chmod OSError after the canonical real local push payload was read and its local temp file cleaned. File removal/cleanup command targets are distinct from backup. Local temp cleanup failure and remote completion after host timeout remain untested.
Canonical healthy acquisition and literal owner-order actions precede fault injection. Single raw identity is tested; multi/entry+cleanup verify attempted actions and original boundary objects only.
contracts.limit: A later failure can be retained solely in OfflineDevice.raised even if the owner discards it. These controls intentionally do not establish owner-level multi-error retention or entry-primary selection; future remedy needs separate concrete aggregation controls if that contract is claimed.

contracts.conclusion: Exact primary and pre-existing cause positives prevent unrelated failures from passing. Existing BrowserLaunchFailures is required only at the actual launched-browser boundary; command-order assertion321 can prevent reaching its later retained-cause assertions.

Exact controlled CancelledError follows an ordinary command fault; canonical cleanup must still attempt all literal later actions. This is a synchronous injected command exception, not live Task cancellation. No broad callback/worker cancellation coverage.

Zero/negative must reject with ValueError before commands. Positive one validates actual canonical intent command exactly once and modeled normal cleanup. Fixed literal ports are command strings only; no host socket bind or network occurs.

forecasts.qualification: These are source forecasts only. Native assertion reachability requires complete actual logs; downstream assertions after the first failure receive no credit.
